title: Ven Pongal
description: A comforting, savoury porridge of rice and moong dal cooked soft together, tempered with ghee, cumin, pepper and cashews — a classic South Indian breakfast.
steps: Dry roast the rice and moong dal together in a pan over low heat for 2-3 minutes until lightly fragrant, then wash and drain.
Pressure cook the rice and dal with the water and salt for 4-5 whistles until very soft and mushy — Pongal should be looser and softer than plain cooked rice.
Meanwhile, heat ghee in a small pan over medium heat. Add the cumin seeds and crushed pepper, letting them sizzle.
Add the chopped ginger, cashews, curry leaves and asafoetida, and fry until the cashews turn golden.

Pour the tempering over the cooked rice-dal mixture and stir well, mashing lightly to combine. Adjust consistency with a splash of hot water if it's too thick. Serve hot with coconut chutney and sambar.
